findings.quote: Sedan 2016 har han låtit resa nio ugnar av Gnistarpstyp intill de utgrävda ugnsplatserna och blåsa dem under kontrollerade former, sammanlagt trettiosex gånger.
findings.note: cross-batch lane clone, student-visible: this is the SECOND CONSECUTIVE LÄS facktext-long built on a rural Swedish furnace craft, and it repeats las-b18-001 (Kalkugnarnas landskap) move for move — a low stone/clay ugn in a named socken, a seasonal work rhythm set by frost and firewood, a named researcher who has surveyed the furnace remains in the landscape, an experimental reconstruction raised beside the excavated sites, and a coda dating the practice. Word counts: ugn* 15 here against 19 in las-b18-001; both titles are built on the furnace itself (Ugnen, luppen och släggan / Kalkugnarnas landskap). The landscape-remains sentence pairs almost line for line ('En ugnsplats syns i marken som en svag grop med sten omkring och en flack hög intill' beside b18-001's 'låga, övervuxna rösen av rödbränd sten, ofta med en grop i mitten'), and the reconstruction move pairs with 'Länsmuseet har nu låtit mura upp en ugn på en av de inventerade platserna'. The motif is four deep in the lane (las-b14-001 kolmilor/tjärdalar, las-b16-001 tegelbrukets fältugn och ringugn, las-b18-001 kalkugnar, this) and two of those four are back to back. The declared family strings differ (kalkbranning- vs myrmalm-blastbruk-facktext-long), so the family-exclusion list did not catch it.

findings.quote: Vad säger texten om hur malmen togs upp och gjordes i ordning?
findings.note: stem echo inside the same lane pair: near-identical construction to las-b18-001's q2 'Vad sägs i texten om hur arbetet vid en ugn var ordnat?', down to the ordna- head. Both are HP-attested forms taken singly (compare host-2020-verb2-LÄS-017 'Vilken roll spelar…'), so this is a bank-diversity finding, not a register defect.

findings.quote: Krokvalls mätvärden har ingen ifrågasatt; det är tolkningen av dem som försöken talar emot.
findings.note: intra-batch thesis-move echo with elf-b19-001, whose paragraph 2 reads 'thinks the count is right and the reason is wrong'. Both of batch19's two long units run the identical adjudication: a named investigator's practical review concedes the incumbent's numbers and refutes her reading of them, and in both the conceder is a man and the incumbent a woman (Tolvsäter/Krokvall; Calverend/Grendisham). Disposition owned at elf-b19-001.

findings.quote: metallurgen Hervor Krokvall
findings.note: name-texture proximity: '-vall' is now the bank's fourth (Ekvall las-b9-003, Skedvall las-b17-002, Gillervall las-b18-001, Krokvall) and its third in three consecutive batches; the b18 ruling tolerated Gillervall~Skedvall as a productive Swedish tail with unrelated onsets, and Krokvall sits at 4 edits from Skedvall and 6 from Gillervall with a distinct onset. Sjunnesberg enters on the very common '-berg' tail (6 edits from Kvedberg), Tolvsäter and Gnistarp sit clear of the registry, and the unit's own log records the intra-batch rename from Rämnestig after gen-las-essa turned up Rämnestad.

disposition: Standalone the unit is register-strong and would sit unremarked beside the exemplars: the sensory scene-first lede ('Det märktes i skaftet') is new to the lane, the residue is genuine and untested (the plogbill that takes in something tungt och rostbrunt, the uppteckningar that are detailed about ownership and silent about the blåsning), the coda stops flat on a charcoal dating, the glossary defines only in-passage words (blästugn/lupp/räckning/varp all verified present), and the numeric register mixes spelled forms with digits reserved for temperatures and centuries. The FLAG is entirely the cross-batch furnace-craft clone against las-b18-001, and it is NOT closed at this gate: adjudication must decide between (a) accepting the pair and retiring pre-industrial fire crafts from the facktext-long lane for at least three batches, or (b) holding this unit and regenerating the lane on a non-combustion craft. The q1 stem should be reworded regardless (any neutral 'Vad framgår om…' form preserves the item). Name proximities weighed and dispositioned WITHIN TOLERANCE: '-vall' has unrelated onsets and no one-letter collision, but no further '-vall' coinage for two batches; '-berg', Tolvsäter, Gnistarp and Alvar/Jerker/Hervor raise nothing. The intra-batch thesis-move echo with elf-b19-001 is weighed here and dispositioned at that unit.

findings.quote: Kommunens egen uppföljning landade på en betalningsgrad om 31 procent av gästnätterna.
findings.note: cross-batch formula echo: the debunk-with-the-council's-own-document move now runs in three of the four consecutive debatt shorts — las-b16-002 'Kommunens egen trafiksäkerhetsbedömning från 2019', las-b18-002 'enligt kommunens egen driftsrapport', and this. The adjacent move, 'the experiment has already been run locally', repeats las-b17-002's 'Nämnden behöver inte gissa vad det skulle leda till, eftersom försöket redan är gjort'. Note that the debunking CONTENT is fresh: b16/b17/b18 all recompute the officials' savings figure, whereas this unit leaves the 61 000 kr cost alone and attacks the revenue assumption instead, then adds a displacement argument no shipped debatt has used.

findings.quote: – Bengta Ödgren, ledamot i badföreningens styrelse
findings.note: persona and name texture: the author-sits-on-the-deciding-body byline echoes las-b16-002's '– Majken Brantmyr, ersättare i barn- och utbildningsnämnden i Flarkbro' (two of four in the lane), and 'Ödgren' enters on the heavily used '-gren' tail beside shipped Aspegren, Ahlgren, Hallgren, Hasselgren, Lövgren and Löfgren; onsets unrelated, 4 edits from the nearest (Aspegren), no one-letter variant. The self-implicating stake the byline pays off ('jag lade min röst för avgiften … Nu vill jag ta tillbaka rösten') is new to the lane and is the unit's strongest register move.

findings.quote: Vässlingsbadet och Stångklippan
findings.note: title variety, intra-batch: batch19 ships two coordinate 'X och Y' Swedish titles (this and las-b19-001's 'Ugnen, luppen och släggan'), against one in the whole shipped LÄS bank (las-b16-002 'Sextioen elever och tjugotre turer'). This one is the weaker of the two, being a bare pair of the unit's two toponyms.

disposition: BATCH WATCHPOINT DISCHARGED, verified mechanically: the debatt does NOT close on a named-month nämnd deadline. The word 'nämnd' does not occur anywhere in the unit (0 hits), no month name occurs anywhere in the unit (0 hits), and the close is a first-person count scene — 'Förra torsdagskvällen räknade jag från bryggan: arton personer uppe på klippan, tre nere vid stegen. Bojen hängde där den hänger, med linan kapad.' That breaks las-b16-002's 'I november ska barn- och utbildningsnämnden … ta ställning', las-b17-002's 'Förslaget bör avslås i februari' and las-b18-002's 'Ärendet ryms på nämndens novembermöte' cleanly, and the three-for-three streak the batch18 disposition named is ended. Weighed proximities and their dispositions: (1) the 'kommunens egen <document>' formula and the local-precedent teardown are TOLERATED for this batch because the debunking mechanism and the persona are both new, but the formula is now three of four and the next debatt should source its counter-evidence from something other than an internal municipal report; (2) the insider byline is WITHIN TOLERANCE — two of four, and the recanted-vote framing makes the insider position load-bearing rather than decorative — with the next debatt asked for an outsider voice; (3) 'Ödgren' is WITHIN TOLERANCE on the '-gren' tail (unrelated onset, no one-letter collision), and Vässlingsbadet/Stångklippan/Vässlingen raise nothing against the toponym registry (Vrantebo, Hyllemåla, Rossmåla, Sölvinge, Flarkbro, Bjässemon, Klyvinge, Härkilsnäs, Ylmaren); (4) the coordinate-title pairing is an intra-batch note only — no rename asked, but the next LÄS batch should not ship two 'X och Y' titles.

findings.quote: Anmälningarna låg kvar, drygt trehundra stycken från hela perioden.
findings.note: lane echo with las-b17-003 (Tjugo sidor anvisningar): both essä shorts run a serial printed ephemeron (planschhandledningar / telefonkataloger), a counted proportion that shifts across decades, a surviving archive of the underlying paper, an interlocutor who tells the author she is over-reading or has it wrong, and a close on the series' last issue and its contents. Much of that is the essä lane's constitutive shape — las-b16-003 also runs a private measurer's archive and a counted trend — which is why this stays minor; the discriminating fact is that the outcome is INVERTED (b17-003's author holds her reading against Bråtemo; here the author abandons hers and gives Rämnestad the point), and 'conventional-view-confirmed' is new to the lane.

findings.quote: – Margit Torpenius
findings.note: name-texture proximity: 'Torpenius' is the bank's fourth learned Latinate surname beside shipped Sundelius (las-b9-003, las-b10-001) and las-b18-003's Brygdelius, which was itself dispositioned within tolerance last batch on the '-elius' tail. Torpenius runs on '-enius', one letter from '-elius' in the suffix but 5 and 6 edits from Sundelius and Brygdelius respectively, with an unrelated onset. Beside it, 'Enar Rämnestad' is a good intra-batch catch by the generators: las-b19-001 renamed its byline off Rämnestig precisely to avoid a Quennerly/Quennerby-class near-pair with this name.

findings.quote: Ledingsbo telefonförening gav ut elva kataloger mellan 1907 och 1931.
findings.note: toponym texture: 'Ledingsbo' enters on the '-bo' tail beside the registry's Vrantebo (itself a batch16 rename forced by the Skarpbo real-place collision); 6 edits apart, unrelated onsets, and '-bo' is among the most productive Swedish settlement suffixes. The unit's own log records the rejection of Snarhult, Ormsäter and Nyhamre on one-letter/exact real-place grounds, which is the Rossmåla discipline applied correctly.

disposition: Register is clean and lane-idiomatic: the result-lede is a genuine essä opening (a count that does not add up), the first-person suspicion is stated and then dismantled by the author's own evidence, the residual honesty is concrete and unresolved (the four hemmansägare who wrote nothing, the two widows keeping their husbands' titles, the overstrikings that may be corrections or changes of mind), the coda stops on a flat publication fact rather than an aphorism, and the glossary defines only in-passage words (fabrikör, hemmansägare — both verified present). Weighed proximities and dispositions: (1) the las-b17-003 lane echo is TOLERATED for this batch on the inverted outcome and the new thesis shape, with a binding forward note — the next essä short must not run on a counted proportion in a serial printed corpus, and should not open on a count at all; (2) 'Torpenius' is WITHIN TOLERANCE, no rename asked — the '-ius' learned-surname family is productive and the onsets are unrelated — but this is the third '-ius' surname in the bank and no further '-ius' coinage should be shipped for two batches; (3) 'Ledingsbo' is WITHIN TOLERANCE on the '-bo' tail with no one-letter collision against Vrantebo or any listed toponym; (4) 'Margit', 'Enar' and the intra-batch Rämnestig/Rämnestad avoidance raise nothing further. All three invented names remain flagged for V-FINAL per rule 14, as the unit's own log states.

findings.quote: Ask anyone in the county who dries grain for money which machine burns, and the answer comes back at once: the mixed-flow, the tall one with the ducts inside.
findings.note: cross-batch opening-formula echo, near verbatim and student-visible. elf-b9-001 (same lane, ELF science-journalism long) opens 'Ask anyone who has argued for the return of beavers to a British headwater what the animals are for, and the answer comes back in cubic metres.' Identical skeleton — Ask anyone + restrictive relative identifying a practitioner group + embedded wh-clause + 'and the answer comes back' + prepositional tail — with the predicate 'and the answer comes back' verbatim. The bank already carries three more of the family: elf-b13-004 'Ask why bread goes stale and the answer comes back that it dries out', elf-b8-004 'Ask a driver how long the white paint on a motorway lasts and the guess is usually years', and elf-b16-002 'Ask anyone on the high street here where the swimming baths are'. This is the fifth instance and the third literal 'Ask anyone'. The unit's law-12 note diffed the opening's CONTENT ('the trade's own belief conceded, not a cost-of-claims lede') and never screened its syntax against the bank.

findings.quote: Garrick Tarrowfen, an economist at the growers’ mutual that writes most of the county’s dryer coverage
findings.note: near-duplicate surname against a shipped bank string, under a standard the batch is applying inconsistently to itself. 'Tarrowfen' is Levenshtein 2 from 'Larrowden', which appears in the shipped passage elf-b14-002 ('a bell of two hundred and forty kilos, cast for the parish of Larrowden'). That is exactly the distance at which the sibling batch19 unit elf-b19-004 rejected its own drafted 'Marrowdene', logging it as 'REJECTED on our own bank: elf-b14-002 carries Larrowden, two edits away'. This unit's rule-8 screen was an exact-string grep of the batch16/17/19 addenda only and never touched the shipped bank for near variants, so the collision was not seen.

findings.quote: Ambrose Calverend, an engineer who spent two winters with those sixty-one files for a growers’ cooperative, thinks the count is right and the reason is wrong.
findings.note: name-texture proximity plus role-archetype echo: 'Calverend' shares the C-lver- stem with batch17's excluded pair Anselm Colverdine (one letter across the first six characters; Levenshtein 4 overall), and it fills the same slot in the same lane — the male auditor of an incident/records file whose count survives while the received reading does not. Colverdine 'audits what the airplanes actually did' in elf-b17-001; Calverend spends two winters with the fire files here.

findings.quote: The first thing he found was dirt.
findings.note: law-9 tidiness: the paragraph enumerates its two results ('The first thing he found was dirt … The second was the clock') and the piece then allots each of its three named experts exactly one paragraph in turn before a fifth verdict paragraph. The exemplars are looser — host-2021-verb2-ELF-040 spends a whole passage of its length on a dome-diameter dispute that no question touches, and elf-b17-001 lets the counting problem sprawl across its close. The finding is the symmetry of the scaffold, not any single sentence; the residue elsewhere (the street of fines shovelled out in February, the trucks waiting at two in the morning) is good.

findings.quote: “What I will defend is the timing,” he says. “Why mixed-flow machines dominate the count is a softer argument, and I think it is about who buys them rather than what is inside them.”
findings.note: intra-batch thesis-move echo with las-b19-001: both of batch19's long units run 'the numbers are right, the reading of them is wrong', adjudicated by a male investigator against a named woman whose data is explicitly conceded (Grendisham's swabs here; Krokvall's mätvärden there). Recorded on both units; the disposition is owned here.

disposition: BATCH WATCHPOINT DISCHARGED: the 'are his' possessive-verdict construction is RETIRED and does not occur — a regex sweep for '(is|are|was|were) (his|hers|theirs)' over all seven batch19 passages returns zero, and this unit's close deliberately reformulates the partial-vindication verdict as prose ('The swabs are hard to walk past … Until then Calverend’s account fits the evidence without having been tested by it'), which is the cheap repair batch18's disposition asked for. FLAGGED on two independently major findings, neither closed here. (1) The opening formula: adjudication should take the cheap repair — any lede that concedes the trade's rule without the 'Ask anyone … and the answer comes back' frame preserves q1's whole-text anchor, since q1 keys on the surviving-count-plus-unsettled-cause pair and not on the first sentence. If the unit ships as written, 'Ask anyone' and 'the answer comes back' should be entered on the law-14 phrase blocklist so no further unit reaches for them. (2) Tarrowfen: a rename is free — no question, key or rationale turns on the name — and the batch should settle on ONE near-duplicate standard, since elf-b19-004 rejected a name at this exact edit distance from the same bank string. Recommend renaming off the -arrow- stem entirely and re-running the rule-14 endpoints. Weighed and NOT requiring action: 'Calverend' is WITHIN TOLERANCE as a string (4 edits, and Colverdine is an excluded pair rather than a shipped-passage name), but the shared C-lver- stem combined with the identical role archetype in the identical lane is worth adjudication's eye, and no further C-lver- coinage should be shipped; 'Ockendale', 'Grendisham', 'Meredith', 'Delphine' and 'Garrick' raise nothing against the registry, and the unit names no toponym, firm or institution at all, so it adds nothing to the saturated place surface. The intra-batch thesis-move echo with las-b19-001 is dispositioned here: the two units may both ship only if las-b19-001 survives its own flag, and if both ship the 'her numbers stand, her reading does not' adjudication is retired for two batches.

findings.quote: – Lettice Thrusselby writes on land and neighbours for a county monthly.
findings.note: a binding batch18 disposition is not honoured. That disposition read: 'the streak is now three and the next cloze must break the construction (bare byline or a different credential syntax).' This is neither. It is the fourth consecutive columnist-credential byline in the lane and the third consecutive instance of the exact frame [Name] + writes + on/about + topic + for a + modifier + periodical — elf-b17-002 'Georgina Chalkwright writes about civic life for a regional weekly.', elf-b18-002 'Prudence Dabbershaw writes a column on working life for a monthly magazine.', behind elf-b16-002 '– Kester Orrenshaw, from a monthly column on English towns'. Dropping the noun 'column' is not a break in syntax; on the contrary this byline is closer to b17-002's frame than b18-002's was. Judged as prose the passage itself is register-clean and needs no repair: an unshowy BrE commentary voice with real residue (the plum tree planted too near the boundary, the strawberry bed under three seasons of couch grass, the concrete path laid in the seventies that still governs where the beds go), no listicle shape, no reader address, and option sets that are single-lexeme and POS-uniform per the lane convention the 2026-07-24 scope rule protects.

findings.quote: the tone of that line is not approving, but it is not ___(4)___ either
findings.note: second consecutive cloze whose polarity gap is the tone of an institutional written instrument — elf-b18-002 gap 2 runs 'beneath the sponge the message is ___' on the laminated notice above the taps. The two units also share their argumentative frame: a written instrument (notice plus rota; no-inheritance clause plus second-refusal rule) that fails to govern conduct around a shared resource, with the passage closing on the instrument's inertness. Distinguishable — b18-002 resolves on temperament, this one declines to resolve at all — but the pairing is the second in a row.

findings.quote: The older hands have a phrase for this among themselves, about waiting for dead men’s ___(3)___.
findings.note: noted, not charged: the gap sets a fixed proverb, which is the lane's own established species (elf-b17-002's 'foregone conclusion', elf-b18-002's 'moral high ground', elf-b16-002's 'second nature'), and three of this unit's five gaps are idiom collocations against b18-002's mixed budget. Within the lane range and within the cloze scope rule; recorded only so the running idiom-density is visible to adjudication.

disposition: FLAGGED on the byline alone; the passage would pass unremarked otherwise. The finding is not that a columnist credit is implausible — it is the lane's natural source frame — but that an explicit, written, forward-binding disposition from batch18 was carried into batch19 and then not executed. Adjudication has a free repair: cut the credential to a bare byline ('– Lettice Thrusselby'), which is what the ELF short lanes already do (elf-b16-004, b17-004, b18-004, b19-004) and which no gap, key or rationale depends on. If the credential is kept for lane identity, it must not use a 'writes … for a …' frame. Recommend the frame itself be entered on the law-14 phrase blocklist so the streak cannot reach five. Weighed proximities and dispositions: (1) 'Thrusselby' pairs with elf-b19-003's 'Ludderby' on the '-by' tail INSIDE this batch, beside shipped Illingsby, Vennerby, Quennerby, Quillenby, Ombleby, Ferrowby, Vaneby and the toponym Owlerby — dispositioned WITHIN TOLERANCE (6 edits apart, unrelated onsets, no one-letter collision against any listed pair, and '-by' is a legitimate Danelaw surname element) with NO further '-by' coinage for two batches; (2) 'Lettice' is a real historical given name and absent from the rule-8 lists, and the unit names no toponym, council, firm or institution at all, so it adds nothing to the saturated place surface — NOT APPLICABLE for toponym proximity, with reason; (3) the tone-of-the-notice gap and the written-rule-against-grown-practice frame are TOLERATED this batch and rest for the next: the next cloze must not gap the tone of an institutional document and must not build on an unenforced written rule.

findings.quote: – Silas Ludderby, writing on the architecture of ordinary streets
findings.note: standing commitment DISCHARGED on its byline half. Batch18's disposition bound the next TYPE-001 short to 'a quoted voice or a non-trade byline'; this is a columnist, which breaks the credential elf-b16-003 and elf-b18-003 shared verbatim ('– Rhoswen Pellowden, building surveyor' / '– Edith Gimberfold, building surveyor'). The quoted-voice half is deferred a second time and the unit discloses the deferral itself. Name texture: 'Ludderby' pairs with elf-b19-002's 'Thrusselby' on the '-by' tail beside the shipped Illingsby/Vennerby/Quennerby/Quillenby/Ombleby/Ferrowby/Vaneby set; 5-6 edits from the nearest, unrelated onsets, no one-letter collision.

findings.quote: Stand across the road from a terrace and count the pots along one stack.
findings.note: intra-batch opening-mood echo: batch19 ships two second-person imperative ELF ledes (this and elf-b19-001's 'Ask anyone in the county…'), and the bank already carries elf-b8-004, elf-b9-001, elf-b10-004, elf-b13-004 and elf-b16-002 in the same family. The verb, construction and rhetorical work here are genuinely distinct from the 'Ask … and the answer comes back' formula charged at elf-b19-001, so the finding is the batch-level uniformity of mood rather than this sentence; standing alone it is a good HP-plausible lede and it does differentiate this short from b16-003's component-first, b17-003's denial-first and b18-003's scene-in-a-loft openings.

findings.quote: A pot is bedded in a fillet of mortar, so a sweep could try a taller one without calling a bricklayer.
findings.note: domain proximity: batch18's disposition asked the next TYPE-001 short to 'leave the mortar/damp domain'. Damp is left — the mechanism here is draught, not water — but this is the third domestic building-envelope masonry short in four (elf-b16-003 open joints above a window head, elf-b18-003 torching mortar under tiles, this pot bedded in mortar), and mortar is again the load-bearing practical detail in the closing sentence. Half the disposition is honoured, half is not.

disposition: Register is the batch's cleanest short and would sit unremarked next to elf-b16-003 and elf-b18-003: plain Anglo-Saxon trade vocabulary, a flat five-word dismissal of the obvious reading ('Pattern tells you very little') set against a 39-token period, genuine non-diagnostic residue (yard stock, householders telling their own door from thirty identical ones, a stack rebuilt in 1961), a counterintuitive mechanism carrying the item, a coda that stops on a practical aside rather than an aphorism, and a stem that predicates nothing about the pots. Every weighed proximity dispositioned: (1) the byline commitment is DISCHARGED and closed; the quoted-voice half is now overdue and should be treated as BINDING for the next TYPE-001 short rather than passed forward a third time; (2) the '-by' pair with elf-b19-002 is WITHIN TOLERANCE — no rename asked — with NO further '-by' coinage for two batches, mirroring the ruling written at elf-b19-002; (3) the imperative-lede pairing is TOLERATED for this unit and charged at elf-b19-001, which owns the verbatim formula; the next ELF batch must not ship two second-person imperative openings; (4) the building-envelope domain proximity is TOLERATED because the mechanism runs on draught rather than damp and the differentiation subject (why NEIGHBOURING instances of one component differ) is new to the lane, but it is now three of four and the next TYPE-001 short must leave the domestic building envelope entirely — not merely the damp within it. 'Silas' and 'Ludderby' raise nothing against the rule-8/9 lists and the unit names no toponym, firm, pattern or maker.

findings.quote: The surveyor's note for that quarter remarked only that the chandler's flap wanted a new spring.
findings.note: lane-motif echo: this is the third TYPE-002 short in five to close on what the record failed to say — elf-b15-004 'Bardsell's report runs to a page and a half and does not mention the summer.' and elf-b18-004 'The wardens' minutes record the new lettings without a word of explanation.' — and it sits beside las-b18-003's coda 'Kommunalstämmans protokoll från det året nämner den inte. Dagordningen ägnas åt vägkassan.' The unit's own law_12_divergence note asserts 'no silence-of-the-record move (the surveyor writes, and what he writes is about a spring)', which does not hold: a record that remarks ONLY on a triviality is the same move in its ironic form, and the family exclusion list already retires 'ELF-TYPE-002 / archival-silence-local-history-inference'. Register otherwise strong and lane-idiomatic.

findings.quote: In the Michaelmas quarter of 1846 the chandler's hatch opened at seven in the morning and took in 412 letters; the bookseller's opened at two and took in 390.
findings.note: note only, no defect: numeric register is genuinely differentiated from the neighbours — bare digit counts and a year against spelled clock hours and a spelled rate ('threepence'), and the two spans the item turns on are never numeralised, where elf-b18-004 ran shillings-and-plans and elf-b17-004 ran £-figures with worked sums. Recorded so the variety is auditable rather than assumed.

disposition: Passes as an excerpt from a local-history essay and would sit unremarked beside elf-b16-004, b17-004 and b18-004: flat past-tense narration, a real administrative rule stated obliquely so no invented rate is attributed to a named real body, unmined residue (the hatch cut beside the shop door, 'not a penny for the letters themselves', the two shops facing each other across the market place), and a bare byline that is the lane's own convention rather than an echo. Weighed proximities and dispositions: (1) the record-notices-a-triviality coda is TOLERATED for this unit — the wording is fresh and the irony is a different beat from a plain silence — but it is now three deep in the lane, the unit's metadata denies it, and the motif is hereby RETIRED: the next TYPE-002 short must not close on what a document failed to record, and 'Motifs now saturated' in the next addendum should name it alongside the wedge-gauge and document-reading-present-tense entries. (2) 'Draystow' and 'Clement Nabbsworth' are dispositioned CLEAR: nearest real neighbours Draycott/Draycote/Drayford at 4 edits, no listed toponym shares a stem (Vrantebo, Hyllemåla, Rossmåla, Sölvinge, Flarkbro, Bjässemon, Klyvinge, Härkilsnäs, Ylmaren, Stintbury, Netherstall, Owlerby, Skelbrigg, Quarnley), 'Nabbsworth' is 9 edits from the nearest listed English surname, and 'Clement' is absent from all three rule-8 lists. (3) CROSS-REFERENCE, not a defect of this unit: this unit's own log rejected the drafted 'Marrowdene' at Levenshtein 2 from the shipped bank string 'Larrowden'; the same test applied to the sibling elf-b19-001 fails its 'Tarrowfen', and adjudication should apply this unit's stricter standard batch-wide. (4) NOT APPLICABLE, with reason: the cloze byline watchpoint, the TYPE-001 quoted-voice commitment and the debatt named-month watchpoint do not touch this lane, and the 'are his' construction does not occur.
